*Source: [Legends of the Spheres](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/447907/Legends-of-the-Spheres?affiliate_id=549120)*

Administrators take an active role in understanding and shaping their situation, viewing conflict as a struggle that expands far beyond the battlefield.

**Special:** This archetype can be combined with archetypes that replace or alter battlefield specialist and/or logistic specialty as long as the administrator does not choose to replace a feature altered or replaced by another archetype.

## Trade Tradition

If this is this character’s first level in any class, the administrator may select a trade tradition of their choice, and have an adroit trade rank.

This replaces the commander’s normal class skills.

## Blended Training

Whenever an administrator would gain a combat talent from his class levels, he may instead choose to gain a skill talent. An administrator uses his practitioner modifier as his operative ability modifier.

This alters combat training.

## Clear Communicator

At 1st level, the administrator gains either the Communication sphere or the Warleader sphere as a bonus sphere. Creatures affected by the administrator’s rapport are considered to be under the effects of the administrator’s tactics for the purpose of the enhanced tactics class feature.

This alters commander.

## Engaging Words

In place of lingering commands, the administrator may select the following option.

#### Rapid Conscription (Ex)

The administrator may form a rapport as a move action with any creature, or as a swift action if he knows the creature’s motivation. The administrator may form a rapport with multiple creatures at once if he knows a motivation for each of them, up to a number of targets equal to twice his operative ability modifier.

This alters lingering commands.

## Utility Expertise

In place of any number of instances of battlefield specialist and logistic specialty, the administrator may choose to gain a [utility] talent at the level where they would gain a battlefield specialist or logistic specialty option.

**U:** Part of Ultimate Spheres of Power and does not need to be bought separately from that book
